events.text: Samuel Dickson Selvon was born in San Fernando.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Samuel Dickson Selvon was born in San Fernando in the south of Trinidad

events.text: Selvon was educated at Naparima College, San Fernando.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was educated at Naparima College , San Fernando

events.text: Selvon has been a wireless operator with the local branch of the Royal Naval Reserve since 1940.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He has been a wireless operator with the local branch of the Royal Naval Reserve since 1940

events.text: Selvon worked for the Trinidad Guardian as a reporter from 1945.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from 1945 to 1950 , worked for the Trinidad Guardian as a reporter

events.text: Selvon's work for the Trinidad Guardian ended in 1950.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from 1945 to 1950 , worked for the Trinidad Guardian as a reporter

events.text: Selvon moved to London, England, in 1950.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Selvon moved to London , England , in 1950

events.text: Selvon was a fellow in creative writing at the University of Dundee from 1975.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Selvon was a fellow in creative writing at the University of Dundee from 1975 until 1977

events.text: Selvon's fellowship at the University of Dundee ended in 1977.
events.subject: self

events.text: In the late 1970s Selvon moved to Alberta, Canada.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the late 1970s Selvon moved to Alberta , Canada

events.text: Selvon died of respiratory failure on 16 April 1994 at Piarco International Airport.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Selvon died of respiratory failure due to extensive bronchopneumonia and chronic lung disease on 16 April 1994 at Piarco International Airport
